SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Acne
Ingredients: Benzoyl Peroxide (BPO): Kills acne-causing bacteria and helps unclog pores
Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA, Salicylic Acid): Penetrates pores to dissolve debris and reduce inflammation
Azelaic acid: Can be less irritating for those with sensitive skin. 15% and 20% are delivered by prescription only, less than 15% is OTC.
Retinoids (Adapalene): Normalize cell turnover to prevent clogged pores and reduce inflammation. Retinoids are delivered by prescription only, but Adapalene is OTC.
Niacinamide: can help manage the appearance of pigmentation, inflammation, and support collagen, both topical and oral

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Pigmentation
Ingredients: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid, L-Ascorbic Acid): Antioxidants can help fade the appearance of pigmentation
Niacinamide: can help manage the appearance of pigmentation, inflammation, and support collagen, both topical and oral
Azelaic acid: Can be less irritating for those with sensitive skin. 15% and 20% are delivered by prescription only, less than 15% is OTC
Alpha hydroxy acids (lactic acid, glycolic acid): can help manage the appearance of pigmentation
Tranexamic Acid: can help manage the appearance of pigmentation
Alpha Arbutin: can help manage the appearance of pigmentation
Hydroquinone: these tyrosinase inhibitors are delivered by prescription only

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Uniformness
Ingredients: Retinol: can help manage the appearance of pigmentation and skin texture
Niacinamide: can help manage the appearance of pigmentation, inflammation, and support collagen, can help manage the appearance of pigmentation, both topical and oral
Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid, L-Ascorbic Acid): can help manage the appearance of pigmentation associated with sun damage
Alpha Arbutin: can help manage the appearance of pigmentation
Hydroquinone: these tyrosinase inhibitors are delivered by prescription only
Tranexamic Acid: Addresses hormonally-induced pigmentation

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Redness
Ingredients: Niacinamide: Can help manage the appearance of pigmentation, inflammation, and support collagen, both topical and oral
Ceramides: Restore barrier function to protect and retain moisture
Azelaic Acid: Reduces redness through anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions. 15% and 20% are delivered by prescription only, less than 15% is OTC.
Allantoin: Antiinflammatory effects to help manage redness
Centella Asiatica: Calms inflammation and supports healing
Green Tea Extract (Camellia Sinensis, EGCG, Epigallocatechin gallate): Potent antioxidant with anti-inflammatory properties

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Lines
Ingredients: Retinol: Support collagen and accelerate cell turnover
Hyaluronic Acid (Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hyaluronan): Adds hydration for skin suppleness
Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid, L-Ascorbic Acid): Antioxidant that protects and supports collagen synthesis
Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHAs, glycolic acid, lactic acid, mandelic acid, citric acid, malic acid, tartaric acid): Exfoliates skin, improving texture and the appearance of fine lines
Peptides: Support collagen or modulate muscle contraction

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Pores
Ingredients: Salicylic Acid: Exfoliates inside the pore lining to help reduce buildup
Retinol: Support collagen and accelerate cell turnover
Clay Minerals (Bentonite, Kaolin): Temporarily absorb excess oil and improve pore appearance
Niacinamide: Regulates sebum and improves cell turnover around pores. Can help with inflammation both topically and orally, which can exaggerate the appearance of pores.
Retinoids (Adapalene): Normalize cell turnover and strengthen structures around pores. Retinoids are delivered by prescription only, but Adapalene is OTC.

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Hydration
Ingredients: Hyaluronic Acid (Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hyaluronan): Attracts and retains water in the skin, providing deep hydration
Glycerin: A powerful humectant that draws moisture into the skin and helps maintain softness
Ceramides: Restore barrier function to protect and retain moisture
Fatty Acids (Palmytic Acid, Linoleic Acid, Oleic Acid, Stearic Acid): Fatty acids in moisturizers to strengthen the skin barrier.

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Dark Circles
Ingredients: Caffeine: Helps reduce puffiness and dark circles by improving micro-circulation
Hyaluronic Acid (Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hyaluronan): Provides deep hydration to plump and smooth fine lines
Peptides: Support collagen production to improve firmness and reduce wrinkles
Green Tea Extract (Camellia Sinensis, EGCG, Epigallocatechin gallate): Potent antioxidant with anti-inflammatory properties

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Puffiness
Ingredients: Caffeine: Helps reduce puffiness and dark circles by improving micro-circulation
Green Tea Extract (Camellia Sinensis, EGCG, Epigallocatechin gallate): Potent antioxidant with anti-inflammatory properties

SKIN_CONCERNS.name: Sagging
Ingredients: Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHAs, glycolic acid, lactic acid, mandelic acid, citric acid, malic acid, tartaric acid): Exfoliate skin and improve texture and fine lines
Retinol: Supports collagen production and accelerates cell turnover to improve skin firmness
